title: mentha × dalmatica var. stachyoides
intro: Mentha × dalmatica var. stachyoides, commonly known as Corsican mint or Stachys x dalmatica, is a hybrid plant that belongs to the Lamiaceae family, combining characteristics of mint and Stachys species. It is used in herbal medicine to alleviate digestive issues, such as nausea and indigestion, and its health benefits also include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which provide its medicinal properties and contribute to its uses in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Mentha × dalmatica var. stachyoides include its ability to calm digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable addition to herbal remedies.
